JOIN 
    yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%'

    yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID AND T3.Date LIKE '2012%'
